title: MUCHOMUSIC: EVALUATING MUSIC UNDERSTANDING IN MULTIMODAL AUDIO-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Implementing an 'audio attention test' that replaces the audio clip with white Gaussian noise or a random track to measure if models inappropriately rely on the text prompt rather than processing the audio modality.
Qualitative evaluation of model failure modes to identify tendencies to output trivial, uninformative phrases that are disproportionately frequent in their LLM-generated instruction-tuning datasets.
